Main Window

File: main_window.py Date: 03/22/2026 Author: Kyle Smith & Tyler Strohl Class: CMSC 420 Description: Primary GUI controller for the Scheduler Pro system. Handles event loops, theme switching, and data visualization.

class app.main_window.MainWindow[source]

Bases: QMainWindow

Main application window for Scheduler Pro.

This class manages the lifecycle of the GUI, coordinates between different configuration managers, and provides the interface for generating and exporting academic schedules.
